pbswi_primary.t: Recapping Wisconsin's 2026 primary election for governor — PBS Wisconsin

races.note: Open seat. Aug 11 primary: D Crowley 39.81% edged Francesca Hong 39.35% (3,673 votes); R Tiffany 95.3% over Andy Manske. Running mates Sarah Godlewski (D), David Varnam (R). No sources reached mention a recount or any third-party/independent nominees; not independently verified. No governor rows in records list.
